en: Psalms 115

p.src: 1  Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.

ja: たちにではなく、 あなたの
してください。 あなたの
en: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.
u.src: 1  Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.

en: 115:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

p.src: 2  Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”

ja: は今どこにいるのか」と。
en: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”
u.src: 2  Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”

p.src: 3  But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.

ja: におられ、 望むことをすべて
en: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.
u.src: 3  But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.

p.src: 4  Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

en: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
u.src: 4  Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

p.src: 5  They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.

en: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.
u.src: 5  They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.

p.src: 6  They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.

en: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.
u.src: 6  They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.

p.src: 7  They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.

en: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.
u.src: 7  They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.

p.src: 8  Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.

ja: も、それらのようになる。 それらに
en: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.
u.src: 8  Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.

p.src: 9  Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

en: Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
u.src: 9  Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

p.src: 10  House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

en: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
u.src: 10  House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

p.src: 11  You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

en: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
u.src: 11  You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

p.src: 12  The LORD remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.

ja: は私たちを覚えておられ、祝福してくださる。 イスラエルの
en: The LORD remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.
u.src: 12  The LORD remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.

p.src: 13  He will bless those who fear the LORD, both small and great.

ja: してくださる。 小さい者も大きい者も。
en: He will bless those who fear the LORD, both small and great.
u.src: 13  He will bless those who fear the LORD, both small and great.

p.src: 14  May the LORD increase you more and more, you and your children.

ja: があなたがたをますます
やしてくださるように。 あなたがたと、あなたがたの子どもたちを。
en: May the LORD increase you more and more, you and your children.
u.src: 14  May the LORD increase you more and more, you and your children.

p.src: 15  Blessed are you by the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

ja: あなたがたは主に祝福されている。
en: Blessed are you by the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
u.src: 15  Blessed are you by the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

p.src: 16  The heavens are the LORD’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.

ja: の天である。 しかし、
en: The heavens are the LORD’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.
u.src: 16  The heavens are the LORD’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.

p.src: 17  The dead don’t praise the LORD, nor any who go down into silence,

ja: も、誰一人ほめたたえない。
en: The dead don’t praise the LORD, nor any who go down into silence,
u.src: 17  The dead don’t praise the LORD, nor any who go down into silence,

ja: 115:17 ヘブル語ではיה（ヤハ）である。
en: 115:17 Hebrew: יה Yah

p.src: 18  but we will bless the LORD, from this time forward and forever more. Praise the LORD!

ja: をほめたたえる。 今よりとこしえまでも。
en: but we will bless the LORD, from this time forward and forever more. Praise the LORD!
u.src: 18  but we will bless the LORD, from this time forward and forever more. Praise the LORD!

en:
115:18 Hebrew: יה Yah
115:18 Hebrew: יה Yah
